data.name: Cleotilde
data.gender_notes: Cleotilde is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Cleo, meaning 'glory,' and tid, meaning 'people.' This name is often associated with the saints Clothilde and Cleopatra, and it represents the glory and honor of God in the hearts and lives of those who bear it. The name Cleotilde carries the meaning “Glory of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Cleotilde usually hope their child will grow to embody glory of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.long_meaning: The name Cleotilde originates from Greek roots, meaning 'glory of God', 'honor of God', or 'fame of God'. Historically used in medieval Christian tradition, it symbolizes reverence and admiration for God. The name carries spiritual significance, reflecting a personality that values devotion, humility, and faith. Cleotilde remains a meaningful choice across Christian cultures.

data.cultural_impact: The name Cleotilde has historical and cultural significance in the Christian tradition, as it is associated with two notable saints in the Catholic Church: Clothilde and Cleopatra. Saint Clothilde was the wife of Clovis I, the first Christian King of France. She is credited with converting Clovis and his people to Christianity through her steadfast faithfulness and prayers. Saint Cleopatra Virginia was an early Christian virgin martyr, who was beloved by contemporary writers for her wisdom, chastity, and diginity. The name Cleotilde reminds us of these influential women who strengthened the faith in their communities and consigned themselves to God.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Cleotilde carries a deep spiritual significance, as it encapsulates the notions of glory and honor that are attributed to God. It is a reminder of the profound impact that faith can have in an individual's life, spreading hope, love, and the message of the Gospel. By bearing the name Cleotilde, one hopes to embody the virtues of cleanliness, humility, and dedication to God, as well as the fortitude and courage displayed by the saints Clothilde and Cleopatra in spreading the Word of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Cleotilde: A name of Greek origin, meaning "glory of the child of God." It symbolizes the radiance of divine grace bestowed upon a precious child of God, shining brightly in the world.
